text:
anya: Noticing another class of canary failures with Kestrel-3B-ptq: tool-call JSON arrays getting split across stream chunks and our parser treats fragments as separate messages (~0.8% on onboarding suite).
sam: Can you paste a minimal example or log snippet?
anya: Sure. Repro with `--batch 12 --stream-chunk-tokens=48 --kv-cache=true`. Log: ```
[chunk A] {"tool": "rank", "items": ["a", "b", "c",

[chunk B] "d", "e"], "meta": {"req": 7}}
```
diego: So the array literal is split mid-list. Our NDJSON stitcher assumes each JSON object is complete within a chunk or separated by newline; arrays spanning chunks break that assumption.
leah: Two quick mitigations: 1) make stitcher buffer until top-level braces/brackets balanced (careful with strings/escapes), 2) detect array-continuation by looking for trailing comma and an open bracket. Which is safer short-term?
sam: I'd prefer a conservative stitcher change: buffer until balanced but cap buffer to 16kb and add heuristic to bail if buffer grows without a close for too long. Also add escape-aware scanning to avoid being tricked by brackets inside strings.
anya: Implemented a prototype that tracks quote state and escape flips. Initial test reduces parse errors to ~0.03%. Edgecases remain when model emits explanatory text before or after JSON like "Here's the list: [ ... ]".
diego: Hmm. Another angle: change runtime token boundary policy to prefer splitting at whitespace or punctuation. But that's invasive and may impact latency.
leah: Also noticed weirdness with trailing commas when model is from PTQ variant — it sometimes emits `, ]` which our strict parser rejects. We should add a tolerant parse path that attempts a quick fix (remove trailing commas, wrap bare values) before failing.
sam: Agree. Make it opt-in for canary: `--lenient-json-postprocess=true`. Add logging of original+fixed payload for audit.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary "kestrel-ptq-021" alert: auto-rollback if toolcall JSON error-rate > 1% over 5m.
anya: I'll land stitcher PR with tests for bracket balance, escaped quotes, and trailing-comma fixup. Running a 5k call smoke run now and will paste results.
diego: Can you also log tokenized boundaries around splits (last 8 and next 8 tokens)? Might reveal if tokenizer emits multi-byte tokens crossing chunk boundary.
leah: Yep, adding token-boundary trace and a small analysis script to aggregate split contexts.
sam: Thanks. If the lenient postprocess reduces failures below 0.2% we'll keep it for canary and schedule a runtime token-boundary project after. Keep updates short. :wave:
